title: 星図のあとに、灯台の光を
author: 猫柳 すず

en.title: Beyond the Star Chart, the Lighthouse Light
en.premise: In a quiet seaside town, an old star chart arrives at the secondhand bookstore run by a woman. It is a mysterious gift that also serves as a map to the "old lighthouse" that once stood in this town. By following the celestial patterns marked on the map, she uncovers hidden memories of small acts of kindness left behind by someone. This is a story of unraveling the feelings of a family, once severed by a misunderstanding.

zh.title: 星图之后，灯塔之光
zh.premise: 在宁静的海滨小镇，经营着二手书店的“我”收到了一份古老的星图。这是一份神秘的礼物，它同时也是一张通往曾存在于这座小镇的“旧灯塔”的地图。循着地图上记载的星象排列，其中隐藏着某人留下的微小善意记忆。这是一个解开因误解而中断的、某段家族情感的故事。
